render_junit_xml_report: generate a JUnit-like XML test report file from a resultset dictionary with configurable suite names
append_junit_xml_results: append test results as a new testsuite element to an existing JUnit XML element tree
create_xml_report_file: write an XML element tree to a report file, creating parent directories if needed
render_interop_html_report: generate an HTML interop test report using a Mako template with client and server language results
render_perf_profiling_results: write an HTML unordered list of performance profiling result links to an output file
